where.if: AND ( p.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.`alias` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.`intro` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `t_pony_tag` t WHERE t.`pony_id` = p.`id` AND t.`tag` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )

mapper.select: SELECT `pony_id` AS ponyId, `tag` AS tag FROM `t_pony_tag` WHERE `pony_id` IN #{pid} ORDER BY `id` ASC

SELECT pc.`pony_id` AS ponyId, c.`id` AS id, c.`name` AS name, c.`icon` AS icon, c.`color` AS color, c.`level` AS level, c.`parent_id` AS parentId, p.`name` AS parentName, p.`icon` AS parentIcon FROM `t_pony_category` pc JOIN `t_category` c ON c.`id` = pc.`category_id` LEFT JOIN `t_category` p ON p.`id` = c.`parent_id` WHERE pc.`pony_id` IN #{pid} ORDER BY c.`parent_id` ASC, c.`sort_no` ASC
